description: Change a saved short link, affecting subsequent redirects and social previews. Preview returns current, updates, and availableFolders; apply only after user approval.

confirmed.description: Preview first; set true after user approval to apply the displayed change.

deepLinkApp.description: Native app that opens the link on mobile; targetUrl must belong to it. null turns it off.

expiredRedirectUrl.description: Where visitors go after the link expires; null clears it.

anyOf.description: When redirects expire; a date alone expires at the start of that UTC day.

expiresAt.description: Expiry date or datetime; null removes the expiry.

externalId.description: Your own ID for the link, such as a CRM record; null clears it.

folderId.description: ID of an existing folder from the link folder list. Use null to leave the link unfiled or clear the folder.

folderSlug.description: Existing link folder slug. Use this or folderId, never a display name.

id.description: Link ID from list_links or search_links.

ogDescription.description: Social preview description; null clears it.

ogImageUrl.description: Social preview image URL; null clears it.

ogTitle.description: Social preview title; null clears it.

slug.description: Path segment of the public short URL; choose a recognizable alias.

websiteDomain.description: Or its domain, such as example.com.

name: update_link

outputSchema.description: message describes the outcome. preview and confirmationRequired identify a review without writing; current and updates show proposed edits when present. link contains its name, slug, destination, expiry, folder and social-preview settings; saved results also include ID and timestamps; success confirms an applied mutation.

title: Update link
